clips.title: The story
paras: Inside Northshire Abbey, Priestess Anetta teaches new priests their first rites of the Holy Light. She is a human cleric and a member of the Brotherhood of Northshire.

On the ground floor of Northshire Abbey, Priestess Anetta keeps to the quiet library wing. Defias bandits and kobolds trouble the valley, and she reminds those who pass that the Light may be the one thing that saves them someday.

New human priests come to Priestess Anetta in the cloister with a hallowed letter of introduction. She teaches them to channel holy words to mend flesh and call down smiting radiance against evil. Under her guidance, the young acolytes prepare to carry the Light beyond Northshire's secluded walls.
